name: Clockwise
tagline: AI calendar optimization for teams and focus time scheduling
painPoints: Team scheduling features require paid plans
No email integration or task creation capabilities
AI is limited to calendar defragmentation, not full productivity
Requires team adoption to see the full benefit
Does not manage communication or tasks outside of calendar
metaDescription: Looking for a Clockwise alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools.
whyPeopleLook: Clockwise is excellent at defragmenting team calendars and creating focus time windows, but its intelligence ends at the calendar. It has no awareness of your email, no ability to create tasks from communication, and no proactive workflow assistance. For individuals who want a broader AI assistant — one that manages their entire productivity stack, not just their calendar — Clockwise falls short.
gaiaReplaces: Focus time protection through calendar-aware scheduling
Meeting conflict detection and proactive rescheduling suggestions
Calendar event creation from email threads
Daily schedule optimization based on task priorities
gaiaAdvantages: Manages email and tasks alongside calendar for holistic productivity
Works for individuals without requiring team-wide adoption
Proactive daily briefings covering all your tools, not just calendar
Free tier available with meaningful features
migrationSteps: Connect GAIA to Gmail and Google Calendar via OAuth
Set scheduling preferences via GAIA's conversational interface
Enable email-to-task creation for complete inbox-to-calendar automation

faqs.question: Does GAIA defragment my calendar like Clockwise?
faqs.answer: GAIA provides scheduling intelligence and conflict detection but does not auto-defragment team calendars. It is stronger at personal proactive assistance than team-wide schedule optimization.

faqs.question: Is GAIA better for individuals than Clockwise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Clockwise's core value is team calendar optimization, which requires team-wide adoption. GAIA is powerful for individual users even without team rollout, because it connects to your personal email and tasks.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require my team to use it for scheduling benefits?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA works independently for each user. You get full benefits from GAIA's email and calendar management without your team needing to adopt it.

faqs.question: How does GAIA compare to Clockwise on pricing?
faqs.answer: Clockwise's paid plans charge per seat. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month for an individual with email, task, and workflow management included. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).
